calibration.issue: w6a HIGH / w6b HIGH: back fabric is one-tone (sparse light dashes on a flat periwinkle ground), with no dark dash set and no brick patches
calibration.status: mostly fixed. There is now a navy dash set, dark/light-dominant cells and brick patches. Hue is 221 against 219-222 in the photos, so the periwinkle is gone. (p90-p10)/p50 is 0.60 (q14) and 0.63 (q13 foreground), against 0.67 (py_37301) and 0.73 (py_37302 foreground). Block std/mean at 6/12/24 px is 0.131/0.105/0.075 (q14) and 0.156/0.138/0.113 (q13), against py_37301 0.176/0.151/0.111. Still left: the light set dominates. Local skew is 0.92-0.98 against 0.06 on py_37301, and only 7-11 % of pixels fall below 0.75x the median, against 15-22 %. The dashes are thin lines rather than fat cells, and the patches render as soft clouds rather than crisp bricks. This is now a medium issue (see issues).

calibration.issue: w6b MED: console body / roller / foot bar same tone as the fabric
calibration.status: fixed. Console side/back is 0.59 in q14, against 0.60 (py_37301) and 0.36 (py_37303). The roller and foot bar now read dark (p8, b1).

calibration.issue: w6a MED / w6b MED: shell too wide relative to the screen, with a chamfered flat top
calibration.status: fixed. In the flat rear view b8 the shell is ~209 px and the bezel 177 px, so shell/bezel is 1.18, against 1.14-1.17 in py_37304 and san_26 (1.29-1.40 before). The top is now a soft arch with rounded corners. The wings stay inside the outline in b2, b3 and b8.

calibration.issue: w6a MED / w6b MED: wings are pale washed-out pillows with weak petals
calibration.status: largely fixed. Wing/back luminance is 1.06 (q14) and 1.08 (q13), against 0.94 (py_37301) and 1.13 (py_37302 foreground). Petals peak at p98/p50 1.54-2.01, against 1.60-2.28. Petal area above 1.4x the median is 4-9 %, against 7-19 %. Still left: the wing ground is too saturated. b7 measures #4d5977 (saturation 0.35) and q14 #6a7796 (0.29), against py_37305 #515361 (0.16) and py_37301 #8590a8 (0.21). (low)

calibration.issue: w6a MED: aisle shroud / shell flanks pale neutral slabs, no sweep line or handle
calibration.status: fixed. q14 shroud/back is 0.85, against 0.82 (py_37301). The q14 flank is #5a6372, against py_37303 #59626d. The silver strip and the handle recess are present.

calibration.issue: w6b MED: back face lacks the hourglass lumbar seams and neck step
calibration.status: partly fixed. There is now a neck step and a shoulder flare (p1, b4). The two curved lumbar seams of py_37301 still do not show; the face reads as soft bolsters without seam lines. (low)
fixed (hue 221). The saturation of the rendered back is 0.24-0.25, against 0.14-0.21 in the photos (py_37302 foreground excepted), so it remains a touch blue. (low)

calibration.issue: w6b LOW: shroud and flanks lighter than the fabric

calibration.status: fixed. The dash scale on the crown matches the face in b6. A different problem remains: the crown itself still shows above the shell rim from behind (new medium issue).

calibration.issue: w6a LOW / w6b LOW: literature-pocket mesh reads as a flat black slot, with no recess
calibration.status: mostly fixed. There is now a grille net band, a dark recess and stitched edges (b2, p6). In q13b at cabin distance it still reads as two dark bars, which is acceptable.

calibration.issue: w6b LOW: leg-rest skirt / foot bar read as light rails
w6a LOW: placards blank / flap rigid / bin housing silver
calibration.status: Placards: not fixed (handed off to integration as an atlas tile). Flap: partly fixed. The lower half now tilts 6 deg, but it is still a rigid 8 mm board with a crisp crease and a lit edge that stands off the headrest (b5). Bin: fixed. The housing is #55595f with silver cups (san_17 / san_20), though it still reads light under the flat studio light (b3).

calibration.issue: w6a LOW / w6b LOW (lighting): sun diamond on the 26A back
calibration.status: not fixed. It is still in q14. This was handed off to lighting and is not scored against PY.

issues.issue: The back fabric is still dominated by its light set. The model shows thin white dashes over soft cloudy patches; ANA's cloth is a dense mosaic of fat light, mid and navy cells with crisp brick patches. At cabin distance (q13, q14) the model reads as white rain on blue camouflage, and the photo reads as grey tweed.
issues.evidence: Local skew (pixel minus 12 px box blur): q14 0.98, q13 foreground 0.92, against py_37301 0.06. Fraction of pixels below 0.75x the median: q14 0.07, q13 0.11, against py_37301 0.18 and py_37302 0.15-0.20. Fraction above 1.25x: q14 0.18, against 0.15. Vertical autocorrelation of py_37305 is still 0.33 at a lag of 3 px on a ~7 px row pitch, so the dash bands fill about 0.55 of the pitch; the tile drops to 0.18 at 3 px on a ~10.7 px pitch (bands ~0.45). Side-by-side: /tmp/claude-0/w7/b/cmp_back.png.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py synth_py_back: (1) Fatten the bands: band half-width 2.4 -> 3.0 px (in both the light and the dark set). (2) Rebalance: out = (1 + 2.2*lite) * (1 - 0.62*dark), with the dark length N(16,4) -> N(19,4) clip(10,28). (3) Make more dark-dominant cells and fewer light ones: dim[dom < 0.3] = 0.4 -> dim[dom < 0.38] = 0.3, and ddim[dom > 0.85] = 0.3 -> ddim[dom > 0.88] = 0.4. (4) Make the patches crisper and quieter: blk sigma 0.22 -> 0.15 and blur 1.0 -> 0.5 px, so the patch read comes from the dominant cells rather than from clouds. Targets on q14: local skew below 0.3, 15-20 % of pixels below 0.75x the median, (p90-p10)/p50 0.6-0.7.
